values.note: State Wildlife Area rule: no more than 14 days on any one SWA in any 45-day period, and a camp, vehicle or trailer may not be left unattended for more than 48 hours.

booking.source: https://cpw.widen.net/s/lslsz2gqlj/chapter-w-9---wildlife-properties (CPW Chapter W-9, general SWA prohibitions #6: 'to camp or to park a travel trailer or camper on any one state wildlife area for more than 14 days in any 45-day period'; 'to leave a camp, pitched tent, shelter, motor vehicle, or trailer unattended for more than 48 hours'; #249 South Republican SWA d. 'Camping is allowed in designated and established camping areas.'), read 2026-10-28

sites.source: The stored 21 sites came from note prose resting only on Campendium (a directory); CPW's South Republican SWA page gives no site count ('Limited amenities are available at the East Beach and North Cove Campgrounds'), read 2026-10-28. Cleared.

note: Colorado Parks and Wildlife campground at the South Republican State Wildlife Area, the former Bonny Lake State Park: the reservoir was partly drained and the park became a wildlife area in October 2011, and North Cove is one of two campgrounds left open (East Beach is the other) with limited amenities. Dry dirt-pad sites among scattered trees on a bench above the old lake bed. Everyone 16 or older on a State Wildlife Area needs a CPW SWA pass or a hunting/fishing license. --Claude
summary: CPW SWA page + Chapter W-9: confirmed camping in designated areas, the SWA pass/license rule and the 14-day limit (14 days in any 45). Cleared sites.count 21 (Campendium only). Fees ($40 for two people, one night of SWA passes) are manual and untouched. Note rewritten.
